def transform(grid):
    # Split at the full-height separator column. The panels share a color;
    # mark cells where that color overlaps in both panels.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and all(grid[r][c] != grid[r][c-1] for r in range(h)) and c > 0)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    base = min(shared) if len(shared) != 1 else next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == base and right[r][c] == base else base for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(h)]
